title: Pocketwire Business Profile Refund Fee Credit — Seller Support Tool Card
content:
**Rule.** On a tier of the Pocketwire Business Profile whose refund terms credit the percentage part of the transaction fee back, a refund earns a fee credit out of the percentage part of the refunded sale's transaction fee, booked against that transaction fee at the refund fee credit worked out for it; the fixed part of the fee and any cross-border fee are never credited back, and on other tiers no fee is credited back.

Each refund on such a tier carries its refund fee credit entry: a fee credit entry of the transaction-fee kind, booked against the transaction fee entry of the refunded sale, which raises the business balance by the credit. The subject this rule governs is the refund fee credit on a profile's refunds.

## The crediting tool: `credit_refund_fee_b8556c63`

**What it does.** A support representative credits back part of the transaction fee of a refunded sale on a Pocketwire Business Profile. One call records a fee credit entry of the `transaction_fee` kind tied to the sale's transaction fee entry, dated today, and raises the business balance by the credit. The owner sees the credit in the profile's activity at once.

**How it is invoked.** It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `credit_refund_fee_b8556c63` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `business_id` | the reference number of the business profile that receives the credit, as returned by the business profile lookup | identifier |
| `fee_txn_id` | the reference number of the transaction fee entry of the refunded sale that the credit is booked against, as listed in the business profile activity lookup | identifier |
| `credit_amount` | the amount credited back | USD, 2 decimal places, zero or positive; rounded half up to the cent before booking |

**Return.** A receipt with `credit_id` (the reference number of the booked fee credit entry), `fee_txn_id` (the transaction fee entry credited), `credit_amount` (USD, 2 decimal places), `credit_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, the booking date), `business_balance` (USD, 2 decimal places, the balance after the credit, or null when the profile was not found) and `status`, always "credited" once recorded. A receipt carrying the credit entry reference and the status "credited" means the credit was recorded.
